title: Frozen Tissue Nuclei Extraction for 10xV3 snSEQ
author: Carly Martin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bi62khge
materials: 5% BSA–DB for FACS (200 ul per sample)
Procedure: ALL buffers to be cooled to 4 o C before use Pre-cool centrifuge to 4 o C Chill all tubes and well plates on ice for 20 minutes before use. Perform all steps on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Dissociation Buffer stock
steps.instruction: Make 500 mL of Dissociation Buffer (DB) with ultrapure nuclease‑free water, adding Na₂SO₄ 5.83 g, K₂SO₄ 2.615 g, Glucose 0.905 g, HEPES 1.2 g, and MgCl₂ 2.5 mL.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 15 mL DB, 150 mg Kollidon VA64, 150 µL TX‑100 (final 1 % TX‑100), 15 µL 10 % BSA (final 0.01 % BSA), and one tube of RNase inhibitor (Lucigen, 10 000 U) to make Extraction Buffer (ExB).

steps.title: Prepare Wash Buffer per sample
steps.instruction: For each sample, mix 30 µL DB, 30 µL 10 % BSA, and 20 µL RNase inhibitor (Lucigen, 10 000 U) to obtain 30 mL of Wash Buffer (WB).

steps.title: Prepare FACS Capture Buffer
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine DB stock (20 mL), 20 µL 10 % BSA, and one tube of RNase inhibitor (Lucigen, 10 000 U) to make 20 µL of FACS Capture Buffer (CDB).

steps.title: Chill equipment
steps.instruction: Place a 26‑gauge needle, a 40 µm cell strainer, and a syringe on ice at 4 °C for at least 20 minutes before use.

steps.title: Coat 12‑well plate with BSA
steps.instruction: Add 1 % BSA to each well of a 12‑well culture plate, incubate, wash with DB, then fill each well with 1 mL ExB buffer.

steps.title: Wash frozen tissue into well
steps.instruction: Pipette 150 µL ExB onto the frozen tissue in its PCR tube, mix, and transfer the suspension into the prepared well.

steps.title: Triturate tissue suspension
steps.instruction: Using a 1 mL Rainin pipette (tip #30389212), pipette the 1 mL suspension up and down slowly 20 times without creating froth, pause 2 minutes, and repeat 4–5 times (add a 5th pass only if dissociation looks incomplete).

steps.title: Pass through 26‑gauge needle
steps.instruction: Pass the entire volume twice through the chilled 26‑gauge needle back into the same well.

steps.title: Dilute in Wash Buffer and split
steps.instruction: Transfer the ~1 mL suspension to a 50 mL Falcon tube pre‑coated with 1 % BSA, add 30 mL Wash Buffer, mix, then split the volume into two pre‑coated Falcon tubes (~15 mL each).

steps.title: Centrifuge nuclei suspension
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 600 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C (centrifuge pre‑cooled to 4 °C).

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant and pool
steps.instruction: Aspirate each supernatant until 500 µL remains in each tube, then combine the two 500 µL residues to obtain ~1 mL total.

steps.title: Filter through 40 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the pooled suspension through a pre‑cooled 40 µm cell strainer by gravity (no pressure) into a clean, pre‑cooled Falcon tube.

steps.title: Transfer to Eppendorf tube
steps.instruction: Move the filtrate to a pre‑cooled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and record its volume.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Add DAPI (Thermo, #62248) to the nuclei suspension at a 1:1000 dilution.

steps.title: Prepare PCR collection tubes
steps.instruction: Coat each 0.2 mL PCR tube with 5 % BSA, then pre‑fill with 20 µL CDB to act as a cushion for the FACS stream.

steps.title: FACS enrichment of singlets
steps.instruction: Run the Sony SH800 (or M800) sorter using a 70 µm chip, speed 6, forward‑scatter gain 1 %, DAPI gate for singlets, purity mode, and do NOT spin down after sorting unless the gentle‑spin protocol will be applied.

steps.title: Collect sorted nuclei in chilled tubes
steps.instruction: Collect sorted nuclei into the BSA‑coated PCR tubes placed on a –20 °C 96‑well cold block to keep the volume minimal.

steps.title: Determine nuclei concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the volume in each tube, make a 1:10 dilution by mixing 18 µL chilled DB with 2 µL nuclei, load the dilution into a Fuchs‑Rosenthal hemocytometer, count nuclei in all 16 large squares, multiply the average count by 10 (dilution factor) and then by 5 (hemocytometer factor) to obtain nuclei/µL.

steps.title: Adjust concentration for 10x v3
steps.instruction: For 10x v3, aim for 17 000 nuclei in 46.6 µL (maximum usable concentration 364 nuclei/µL). If the measured concentration is lower, proceed to the gentle‑spin concentration step.

steps.title: Gentle‑spin concentration (if needed)
steps.instruction: Coat a 0.5 mL Axygen tube (321‑05‑051) with BSA, drain completely, and chill on ice together with a 2.0 mL Axygen holder tube (MCT‑200‑C) in a Labnet PrismR centrifuge. Add up to 200 µL of nuclei suspension, spin at 200 × g for 1 minute at 4 °C, stop, then spin again for 1 minute at 200 × g, stop.

steps.title: Aspirate to desired 10x volume
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate from the top of the tube to remove excess supernatant, leaving the volume that will give the desired concentration in the final 46.6 µL 10x input; verify that no nuclei are lost during aspiration.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei before loading
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the nuclei (no visible pellet) by up‑and‑down pipetting 2–3 times before adding the suspension to the 10x Chromium chip.
